manufacturing_pmi.rationale: Current TradingView U.S. BCOI page identifies the series as ISM Manufacturing PMI / business confidence.

services_pmi.rationale: USNMPR is non-manufacturing Prices, while NMPMI is the non-manufacturing PMI.

core_cpi.transform: use directly as core inflation YoY percent

core_pce.original: ECONOMICS:USPCEPIAC incorrectly named pce_core then YoY-transformed again
core_pce.rationale: CPCEPI is Core PCE Price Index level; compute YoY exactly once.

jolts_openings.rationale: Original comments intended rate-form JOLTS inputs.

zscore_startup.intended: if mean/std unavailable -> na; else if std == 0 -> 0; else (src-mean)/std
zscore_startup.rationale: The literal helper zero-fills insufficient lookback history in Pine v5. Intended semantics require a real 120-month normalization window before the score is considered available.

formulas.zscore: if sma/stdev over 120 months are unavailable -> na; if populated stdev == 0 -> 0; otherwise (src - sma120) / stdev120

normalization_and_sample.warning: The usable modern sample is short and contains only a few policy cycles. No structural multi-era claim is permitted.
normalization_and_sample.startup_policy: No zero-fill for insufficient history. Full dependent chain must be non-na before P/R/PS is eligible for validation.

data_access_boundary.ism_history_reason: ISM historical PMI data are subject to access/usage restrictions. Use TradingView runtime data; do not scrape or redistribute raw ISM history.

validation_timing.rationale: Two-month signal lag reduces macro publication-timing leakage.

continuous: Pearson correlation P[m-2] vs future 6m EFFR change
Pearson correlation R_hawk[m-2] vs future 6m EFFR change
Pearson correlation PS_intended[m-2] vs future 6m EFFR change
primary_tests.incremental_question: Does PS_intended add useful policy information versus P alone, without optimizing weights?

pivot_event_study.event: PS_intended zero crossing at signal observation month s
pivot_event_study.outcome: FEDFUNDS change from recognition month s+2 to recognition+horizon

hard_rules: Do not alter original default weights or the 120-month z-score window.
Do not tune PS thresholds after outcomes are viewed.
Do not add Treasury or portfolio returns.
Do not call this exact original BCI-10.
Do not replace PMI runtime fields with scraped or redistributed ISM history.
Do not change R_hawk sign repair after validation.

comparison_signal_classes.rule: Same +/-0.3 cutoffs as PS are used only for fixed diagnostic classification; no cutoff optimization.
